artworks.title: The Ascension
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people with most of their bodies shown, kneeling or standing in various positions, all focused on a central figure that appears to be ascending. The individuals have hair of various styles, ranging from curly and short to long and wavy. Their facial features are rendered with expressive details, showing them in a variety of poses, all looking upwards. Each person is dressed in flowing robes with folds and detailed textures. There appear to be no visible items of jewelry, nor are they holding any objects. In the background, a cloudy sky is depicted, with the focus drawn towards the central figure disappearing into the heavens, largely obscured by clouds. The scene is framed by a simple border.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.description: This is an image depicting a group of robed figures in a room, gathered around a central point. Above them is a dove with outstretched wings, emitting rays of light. The figures are looking towards the dove.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious or spiritual scene. In the center, a figure is seated on a throne-like formation amidst clouds, flanked by two angels with trumpets. Below, two figures approach in reverence. The bottom section shows a crowd of figures interacting. On the right, a large creature with an open mouth, and on the left, a radiant light. The drawing features detailed line work and shading typical of woodcuts or engravings, creating a contrast between light and shadow that emphasizes the spiritual nature of the scene.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing under a tree entwined with a serpent, with various animals in the foreground. It depicts a scene in a forested area where two nude figures are embracing each other beneath a tree that has a serpent wrapped around its trunk. In the background, there are large leaves and fruits. In the foreground, there is a wild pig on one side and a goat and a small dog on the other. The scene is detailed with intricate line work, capturing the texture of the tree bark and the fur of the animals.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene featuring three distressed figures and an angel holding a cross. The foreground shows three figures, two sitting and one reclining. An angel holding a cross is in the upper left corner interacting with the figures. The background shows a natural setting with hills, trees, and a wooden structure on the right. The style features strong lines and dramatic shading.

artworks.title: Cain Killing Abel
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing two muscular figures in a conflict. One figure stands wielding an axe above the other figure lying on the ground. The standing figure has intense facial features. A tree and foliage are in the background. The composition is detailed and emphasizes the anatomy and emotions of the figures. The date "1511" and a symbol are featured above the figures.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures under a wooden structure. The scene shows multiple individuals gathered beneath a rustic timber canopy. The beams and rafters of the structure are depicted in detail. The attire of the figures is intricately detailed, suggesting historical or narrative garments with flowing robes and textures. Above them, a single star is visible in the sky, casting light over the gathering. The ambiance is one of reverence and focus, centered on the interaction in the foreground. The composition features strong lines and fine shading, typical of classic woodcut drawings.

artworks.title: The Mass of Saint Gregory
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with detailed figures and symbols. The drawing depicts an altar where an individual is kneeling in prayer or reverence, while another figure appears to be directing attention to a figure of significant religious importance. An arrangement of ladders, candles, and symbols surrounds the altar. A central figure takes a prominent place, and an angelic being is portrayed amongst clouds in the background. Various religious and ceremonial elements are depicted, including ornate robes, a chalice, and a crucifix. The drawing is intricately detailed, emphasizing lines and textures.

artworks.title: The Trinity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with figures among clouds, held aloft by angels. The figures are seated on clouds with a dove in the sky above them. Rays of light emanate from behind one of the central figures. Below, clouds are stylized with faces blowing winds. The composition is intricately detailed, with emphasis on the flowing garments and the serene expressions of the winged figures surrounding the central group.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a child. The man is using a long staff as he walks through shallow water. The man has a beard, wears a crown made of leaves, and a robe with a belt. The child sits on the man's shoulders. The background includes hills, a tree, and a second figure holding a lantern. The scene seems to be during the day.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Joachim and Anne under a Tree
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed black and white illustration of four figures and a baby. The central focus is on a seated woman holding a baby, with the child's legs being supported by another woman seated beside her. The woman's face is visible, featuring smooth facial features and medium-length hair styled with a headband. She wears a garment with detailed draping, possibly a dress, with some kind of embellishment near the neck. To her left, another woman is bending forward, partially holding the baby, and has her head covered with a headscarf, showing an aged face with prominent features. Behind them, two standing figures are visible; one is an older man with curly hair and a beard, wearing a cloak or robe, leaning slightly to observe the baby. The other is a woman with her head and most of her face covered, holding a string of beads or rosary and possibly wearing layered clothing with a visible belt. The background suggests an outdoor scene with a tall, sturdy tree in the middle, surrounded by sparse foliage and trees, alongside a building with visible windows at the right edge. The artwork is finely detailed with an intricate appearance typical of woodcut or engraving. Above, the image includes a date, 1511, and a monogram.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Music-Making Angels
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures gathered outdoors beneath large trees. A seated woman cradles an infant in her arms, her head adorned with a headdress. Another seated woman wraps a cloth around a baby. Surrounding them are men with long beards and detailed facial features, dressed in flowing robes topped with hats or hoods. One of the men on the left carries a pitcher, a sword at his side. Small cherubic figures are seated close to the central women, with one holding a book. The background shows a serene, rural setting with rolling hills and grazing sheep in the distance, with the trees framing the scene. The engraved year "1511" appears at the top of the composition.

artworks.title: The Virgin Crowned by Two Angels above a Landscape
artworks.description: This is an image of a circular frame containing a detailed religious scene, depicting a crowned figure with curly hair and two winged beings. Below the frame is a landscape with cliffs, a tree, and a village in the distance.

artworks.title: The War at Hainault
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval battle scene. It shows two armies clashing in front of a medieval town. The soldiers are armed and wearing armor, helmets, and various headgear. They wield spears, swords, and shields in a crowded and dynamic skirmish. The background includes the town with buildings and mountains. The drawing features fine lines, cross-hatching, and detailed textures.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a man crucified on a cross, a woman to the left and another man to the right. Above, there is a deity surrounded by clouds and angels, and the intricate border features floral patterns and smaller angelic figures. The background includes trees and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene with two armored horses and riders. One rider is wearing elaborate armor and is carrying a lance and banner, accompanied by a heraldic lion figure. Another armored horse appears to have fallen with its rider represented by an animal form tangled in armor and limbs. The background includes clouds and dynamic lines. The artwork emphasizes dramatic and humorous elements using detailed linework and contrasting positions of the two figures.

artworks.title: Masquerade Dance with Torches
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to block): 22.7 × 25 cm (8 15/16 × 9 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group dance in a medieval or renaissance setting. In the center of the image, figures in period costumes partake in a formal dance on a checkered floor. The dancers are dressed in elaborate garments typical of the Renaissance era, with capes, patterned tunics, and feather-adorned hats. The background features an upper level where additional observers, dressed in similar ornate attire, peer over a balcony. Ornamentations and architectural details enrich the setting, giving it a sense of grandeur and nobility. The woodcut technique emphasizes the textures and details of the characters’ outfits and the decorating elements surrounding them.

artworks.title: The Virgin Surrounded by Many Angels
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving showing several figures. In the center is a seated woman holding a child. The woman has a halo and a floral crown, long curly hair, and is dressed in flowing robes with intricate patterns. Surrounding them are winged angels and cherubs, each with unique hairstyles and features. Some angels hold floral bouquets, while others have instruments. In the background, two large angels hold a crown over the woman’s head, with swirling clouds and more angelic figures. The composition is highly detailed, with elaborate clothing, wings, and expressions on each character, creating a celestial atmosphere.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of the German Empire and Nuremberg City
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a heraldic composition with allegorical elements. The image includes two winged figures seated on clouds at the top, holding symbols of justice and abundance. Below them, a crowned double-headed eagle emblem is featured. Additional winged figures on either side appear to be supporting shields bearing smaller heraldic symbols. The style of the drawing indicates an intricate and orderly execution, typical of early 16th-century engravings.

artworks.title: Ulrich Varnbüler
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person's upper body up to the chest, displayed in profile facing to the right. The person has a strong facial structure with a prominent nose and slightly tilted-up head. He has a curly short beard, and his hair is mostly covered by a large, elaborate hat. The person is wearing a high-collared garment with visible stitching and layered fabric. Near the right side of the image, there is a decorative inscription in Latin on a scroll. The background consists of fine horizontal lines, creating a textured backdrop for the portrait.

artworks.title: Ulrich Varnbüler
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to block): 43 x 33 cm (16 15/16 x 13 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man in a profile view. He has distinct facial features, with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a jutting chin. He has a beard and hair on his chin and sideburns, partially covered by an elaborate hat. The man wears a garment with padded shoulders and a low neckline, and there are no visible accessories in his hands. The background is dark with woodcut lines, contrasting with the tan tones of his face and clothing. An inscription "ULRICHVS VARNBVLER" and a decorative scroll with Latin text are visible in the image.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated around a long table. A table is centered in the drawing, covered with a cloth and various items placed upon it. Several figures are leaning over the table from both sides. Behind them, the background suggests a wall with lined texture and small windows. A round, luminous object is depicted above the central figure. The architecture and furnishings depicted have a medieval or Renaissance quality.

artworks.title: Justice, Truth and Reason in the Stocks with the Seated Judge and Sleeping Piety
artworks.description: This drawing depicts figures representing virtues and vices in an allegorical scene. The central figures are labeled 'Gerechtigkeit' (Justice), 'Warhatt' (Truth), and 'Vernunft' (Reason). Justice holds a sword, while another authoritative figure on the right holds a rod and sits on a throne-like chair labeled 'Ich bin die frucht'. An infant is depicted in a cradle below this figure. The artwork includes symbolic characters and text elements in a style similar to woodcut illustrations from the late medieval or early Renaissance period.
